requirements_summary: Workloads: live chat agent-assist + post-chat ticket summarization + nightly batch reranking for support search.
Latency targets: median < 150ms per token for autoregressive completions in live chat; end-to-end suggestion latency < 400ms.
Throughput targets: sustain 600 concurrent chat sessions on peak; burst to 2x for campaign windows.
Cost sensitivity: mid-high; looking for unit-cost savings via batching and KV prefix caching but will pay for SLA on spikes.
Model preferences: prefer open/quantized Llama-family variants for private deployments, but will consider Redwood-verified alternatives; need deterministic fallbacks.
Routing/fallback: policy-based regional routing to EU-dedicated capacity, automatic fallback to lower-precision model only if latency SLO maintained; no silent model switches without audit trail.
Security/compliance: EU data residency, SSO for agents, audit logs for every model call, ability to purge PII, KMS integration for key control.
